messages.author: ee981dabe3871fb7
messages.subject: Push Formula on Homebrew
parts:
I think I would be nice if user can easily install the command line tool from homebrew without interacting with CRAN / R. I drafted a homebrew formula and opened a PR. Please feel free to give any feedback or provide any help.

https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/pull/98816

In particular, I couldn't figure out how to install it in a way that does not require the user to manually set the R_LIBS environment variable. Homebrew would not give me permission to install it in the system level R library (for good reasons).

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] Push Formula on Homebrew
parts:
Thanks for trying anyway. Don't be too worried about it because CRAN provides binaries for MacOS, so it is easy to do 'install.packages("irace")' without requiring anything else besides installing R.
 
For the development version, it is slightly more complex because you need a C compiler installed, but once you have that, it should be a matter of doing: "devtools::install_github("MLopez-Ibanez/irace")".

R is not great. If I had to start implementing irace today, I would choose Python (or possibly Julia), but reimplementing everything is Python or Julia is beyond my available time now. But I'll be happy if somebody started such a project. If you are planning such a project, get in touch with me, I can offer you some guidance so you can avoid some "mistakes" we did along the way in R's irace.

Cheers,

Manuel.
